answer: Make every identity plant one timber bond before it can speak: a locked stake that matures only after the identity contributes real, checkable work, and each epoch a comet — a random beacon — strikes a sample of identities and re-checks one past contribution step by step from its seed to its signature. Honest agents plant once and pass cheaply. A flood of fakes must each lock its own timber and survive the comet audit, so every fake costs the full stake and a thousand fakes cost a thousand stakes, while the oasis of shared rewards only waters identities whose bonds still stand.
